vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate's defaults already bypass 'schedule' and 'minimumReleaseAge' here, so a CVE fix is not held back to Monday

packageRules.description: config:recommended maps depType 'dependencies' to 'fix', which in a release-on-commit-type repo publishes an artifact. Releasing must be opt-in, so reset everything to 'chore'; repos that publish re-enable 'fix' for their own runtime dependencies, listed exactly.

Bundle everything else's minor/patch bumps into one PR to cut noise; majors stay separate for review. Placed before the build-tooling/test-dep rules below so those keep their own distinct group names instead of falling in here.
Build tooling never reaches users, so its updates must not trigger a release
GitHub Actions digest/pin bumps are hash-only, not new code -- safe to merge unattended for any repo, not just ZirekHQ's
Test-only libraries are not part of any published artifact

First-party ZirekHQ artifacts (crates, wheels, npm/Maven/Go packages published from other ZirekHQ repos, and internal reusable GitHub Actions workflows) carry no third-party supply-chain risk -- skip the release-age wait and group them for one combined review.

Auto-merge first-party patch/minor bumps once CI passes -- the org controls both ends of the dependency, so review overhead outweighs the risk for non-breaking bumps. Major bumps still need a manual look.
